arguments.summary: Removed the deprecated `legacy_export` handler from api/handlers.py and its entry in `_REGISTRY`, so it no longer appears in `registry()`. Kept `stats` since it's only tentatively marked deprecated (see #250). Added a 2.0 changelog entry noting the removal. All existing tests pass and no code references to `legacy_export` remain.
